label: D1 after an a2 choice that hit S1 by a rare transition, mid-episode, while the agent strongly prefers a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass), and 85% of mass falls on D1 steps right after an a2 choice that reached S1 by a rare transition. The other 15% is at the first D1 of the window (rel -3), where the previous trial is outside the window and cannot be checked. The predicate uses only observed variables: the previous action, its transition, the agent own policy logit and episode time. The unit almost never fires after a1 choices or after common transitions, and never at GO or D2. Rarely active before episode trial 20 or after trial 70; most activity is at trials 30-69, so it is gated by time in the episode. Its activations also cluster at a narrow band of value (7.1-7.5) and at a strong a2 preference (choice < -1.5). Previous reward modulates magnitude: the strongest activations follow a rewarded rare trial (r1), and unrewarded ones are weaker. The prev_action/prev_common predicate alone gives F1 0.34 (recall 0.84). Adding the episode-time window and the a2-preference condition raises precision to 0.57 (dev F1 0.65). Many rare a2->S1 D1 steps still stay silent, with no clean observable that separates them.
